'''''Arctotis''''' is a [[genus]] of [[annual plant|annual]] and [[perennial plant|perennial]] plants in the family [[Asteraceae]].<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/358943#page/364/mode/1up Linnaeus, Carl von. 1753.  Species Plantarum 2: 922-923] in Latin</ref><ref name=f>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40018847 Tropicos, ''Arctotis'' L. ]</ref>

''Arctotis'' is [[native plant|native]] to dry stony slopes in southern [[Africa]]. Some of the plants are alternatively placed in the genus ''Venidium''. The common name is "African daisy", or "Gousblom" in [[Afrikaans]]. These plants have daisy-like [[pseudanthium|composite]] flowers which tend to close in the late afternoon or in dull weather,<ref>{{cite book|title=RHS A-Z encyclopedia of garden plants|year=2008|publisher=Dorling Kindersley|location=United Kingdom|isbn=978-1405332965|pages=1136}}</ref> but numerous cultivars have been developed for garden use which stay open for longer, and are available in a wide range of colours. [[Hardiness (plants)|Tender]] perennials are often grown in [[temperateness|temperate]] regions as half-hardy annuals.

The garden [[Hybrid (biology)#Hybrid plants|hybrid]] ''A.'' × ''hybrida'' [[hort.]] 'Flame' has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web|title=RHS Plant Selector - ''Arctotis'' × ''hybrida'' hort. 'Flame'|url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/89915/Arctotis-x-hybrida-hort-Flame/Details | accessdate=23 February 2020}}</ref>  

Vigorous ''Arctotis'' hybrids like 'Pink Sugar'<ref>{{Cite web|date=2018-03-06|title=Garden Coach: Cold, wet weather, lack of sun and improper planting can take a toll on African daisies and irises|url=https://www.mercurynews.com/2018/03/06/garden-coach-cold-wet-weather-lack-of-sun-and-improper-planting-can-take-a-toll-on-african-daisies-and-irises/|access-date=2021-10-28|website=The Mercury News|language=en-US}}</ref> and 'Large Marge' are popular choices for garden design for the diverse colors of their blooms.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Photos: Daisies perfect for your desert garden|url=https://www.desertsun.com/picture-gallery/life/home-garden/maureen-gilmer/2020/01/28/photos-daisies-perfect-your-desert-garden/4600992002/|access-date=2021-10-28|website=www.desertsun.com|language=en}}</ref>
